availability: Temporary development service; host PC must remain running.
release_notes: Responsive mechanical steering and balanced front tire grip on all four cars, with safe speed-sensitive steering limits.
Live 0–100% steering sensitivity, default 50%, with separate keyboard, gamepad, mobile and virtual-wheel profiles; saved response, centering and deadzone settings.
Optional vector racing steering wheel with continuous multi-touch input, adjustable size, opacity, placement, rotation and centering.
Compact BACK / R control brakes forward motion, waits near standstill, then reverses. Releasing it removes reverse throttle; GAS safely returns to forward gear.
Manual accelerator and automatic gears by default. Full GAS uses the same engine and gearbox on desktop and mobile at 120 Hz physics.

Hold GAS + steering + DRIFT for controlled oversteer. Easy, Normal and Expert assistance provide progressive grip loss and recovery; Expert needs active countersteering. Optional one-tap recovery remains available.
Tire contact smoke and pooled skid marks, corrected remote wheel-spin interpolation and replicated road-surface normals.
Smooth chase and drift camera rotation, preserved original cars, track textures and camera-frustum mobile scenery optimizations.
Authoritative multiplayer handling revision 3 requires version 0.8.0; legacy host handling remains negotiated. Preview clients can now receive newer preview update notifications.
Development preview: real Android installation, resume, gameplay FPS and phone/Windows cross-play remain unverified until a physical phone is available.
limitations: Real-phone installation, Android + Android and Android + Windows tests remain unverified.
Multiplayer currently needs the host PC running. The temporary server hostname can change; the game checks this website for its current endpoint.
